source: OSRM public demo server over OpenStreetMap data (road geometry, distance, free-flow duration)
traffic: Not live. The model applies a simulated traffic multiplier to free-flow durations.

heavy_traffic.label: Heavy Traffic
heavy_traffic.explain: Congestion slows every road in the city.

road_closure.label: Road Closure
road_closure.explain: The planned road is closed ahead, forcing a long detour.

temperature_rise.label: Temperature Rise
temperature_rise.explain: A heat wave raises the temperature at the hub and on the road.

refrigeration_failure.label: Refrigeration Failure
refrigeration_failure.explain: The truck cooling unit stops working.

humidity_problem.label: Humidity Problem
humidity_problem.explain: Wrong humidity makes produce wilt or rot faster.

buyer_cancellation.label: Buyer Cancellation
buyer_cancellation.explain: The planned buyer cuts or cancels the order.

price_drop.label: Sudden Price Drop
price_drop.explain: The planned buyer lowers the price it will pay.

product_damage.label: Product Damage
product_damage.explain: Some produce is bruised during loading.
